answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 65462 Country: India Title: Discharge of Madi during salah Question: I am 26 years old and have a question about madhi. Whenever I think of a girl or talk to any woman a drop of madhi comes out. The madhi keeps on coming out after that and even while I am in namaz a drop emits out. I keep a toilet paper to absorb the impurity however this is everyday's case. I am afraid that after talking to a girl I cannot go for namaz, even if I wait long this increases the chances for getting that namaz to get Qaza. To avoid this I am offering namaz very fast so that madhi doesn’t come out and beak my wudhu which is affecting my Khushu and khuzu. Can you please help me understand what should I do in such situation as I cannot stop the madhi in my namaz and cannot make my namaz qaza. We know that wudhu breaks if anything comes out of the private parts, however I can stop the madhi during namaz. What should I do? Answer ID: 65462 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 784/782/N=08/1437) The Shariah ruling is the one which you know. The solution to the problems mentioned in the question is that you must keep your mind free from lust and related thoughts and do not turn your mind towards the girls at all and in case sometime it diverts towards them then turn it towards other side immediately and do not talk the women or girls without severe need. If you do these things then it is hoped that your problems shall gradually be solved or reduced. May Allah redress your problems! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
